calibration_anchor.closest_anchor: Seed-stage product launch with AI buzzwords, no proof
calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: No data, no customers, no exclusive access; 'AI agents and humans working together' is a generic category claim repeated by dozens of companies; Product Hunt trending is not a journalist hook
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: There is an identifiable beat (AI/enterprise software) and the collaboration-workspace category is at least a recognized area of reporter interest, preventing a floor score

beat_relevance.rationale: AI/enterprise software is a real beat and collaboration tooling is a known area of coverage, but reporters on this beat see dozens of identical 'AI + humans working together' pitches daily — the beat is right but the story is indistinguishable from noise

timeliness.rationale: The only timing signal is today's Product Hunt launch. No external news hook, no regulatory moment, no earnings cycle. Trending on Product Hunt is not a press calendar event

magnitude.rationale: Unknown seed startup with 466 upvotes on Product Hunt. No user count, no enterprise customers, no revenue. The claimed audience is a community platform vote, not real-world adoption

proof_points.rationale: No data, no named customers, no exclusive access, no technical proof of differentiation. 'Seamlessly' and 'the future of human-AI collaboration is here' are marketing claims, not evidence

narrative_quality.rationale: The framing ('the future of human-AI collaboration is here') is a generic category slogan. There is no specific conflict, protagonist, consequence, or surprise — identical language appears in hundreds of AI startup pitches

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown seed startup, no named founders with credentials, no independent validation, no investor roster that adds standing

improvement_suggestions: Do not pitch 'the future of X is here' — it is a buzzword, not a story
Surface a specific, named enterprise customer who eliminated a measurable handoff delay using the product
Add first-party data: time saved per workflow, error rates reduced, or cost per task before and after
Tie to a concrete live moment — a specific company deployment, a case study, or a measured productivity outcome

evidence_used.title: Vokal Product Hunt launch: top-3 trending with 466 upvotes, angle 'the future of human-AI collaboration is here'

evidence_gaps: No enterprise customer names or anonymized case studies
No usage metrics (active users, workflows automated, time saved)
No technical differentiation from existing AI-collaboration tools
No independent press coverage or analyst validation
honest_assessment: AI topicality is not a story. Every week brings dozens of 'AI agents and humans working together seamlessly' pitches to the same reporters. Without data, named customers, or a genuinely novel technical proof point, this is generic category marketing dressed up as a launch. The Product Hunt ranking is not a hook. This is not a story yet.

next_move.rationale: Hold until a named customer proof point, first-party usage data, or a concrete technical differentiator can be surfaced
